subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brave
solution:
The correct answer is: Brave.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Brave"** means showing courage and being ready to face and endure danger or pain. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example: **He was **brave **enough to stand up to the bully.
 
 
 
• **"Coward"** refers to someone who lacks the courage to face danger, difficulty, or pain. (कायर)
 
 
• **Example: **He was called a **coward **for running away from the fight.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Brave'** is **'Coward'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Courageous** (साहसी): Having or showing courage.

 
 
• **Example:** The **courageous **firefighter saved the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **Shallow** (उथला): Lacking depth of intellect or knowledge.
 
 
• **Example: **His understanding of the subject is quite **shallow**.
 
 
 
• **Foolish** (मूर्ख): Lacking good sense or judgment.
 
 
• **Example:** It was **foolish **of him to ignore the warning signs.
